root_causes.finding: Topology spreading placed two AgentOps seats on rhgnr1, but that worker lost its container runtime and became NotReady during provisioning. It suffered another network and NotReady event during cleanup. Current Ready and pod-headroom checks did not represent workload-specific worker stability.

ThreadPoolExecutor had already queued all seats. After workshop reclaim changed the order to reclaiming, a queued fifth seat still entered provisioning, created a session and namespace, and reached health before reclaim could delete it.

The worker outage delayed pod termination and stale operator finalizers. The ephemeral NFS provisioner removed five of six interrupted-seat volumes, but root-squash could not delete one PostgreSQL tree owned by the deleted project's UID.
